name: Form 3 Geography: Types of Weathering
subject: Geography
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to describe the three types of weathering
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to give examples of physical weathering
learningActivities: Discussion: learners observe weathered rocks in the school compound
Explanation: teacher explains physical, chemical and biological weathering
Group work: learners classify examples of weathering
Application: learners explain how weathering affects rocks
keyPoints: Weathering is the breakdown of rocks in situ
Physical weathering involves the breakdown of rocks without change in composition
Chemical weathering involves changes in the chemical composition of rocks
commonMisconceptions: Thinking weathering involves movement of rock materials
lessonEvaluation: Learners describe the three types of weathering and give examples.
teacherReflection: Clear understanding. Emphasise that weathering occurs in situ.
